# 3 bed detached house for sale

> James Murphy Kinsale Property is delighted to present this development opportunity, currently laid out as a cosy 3-bedroom, 1-bathroom detached early 1900's Irish Cottage, The property stands on 1.186 Acres ( 0.48 Hectares) and has front and rear gardens with ample private car parking. It is standing on a private, spacious East to South facing site.

- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bed
- Plocha: 55 m²
- Energetická náročnost: G
- Lokalita: Dunderrow, Kinsale
- Cena: 300 000 €
